summary: Use independent fixture seats and sequential child admission under default mission capacity.

schema.detail: Fixture declarations and setup only: a distinct parent seat preserves child queue order, while separate root/child missions admit and complete children sequentially under unchanged default one-active-run capacity. Production predicates and all input, status, date, lease and digest assertions remain.
